project.summary: Unified notification push for DeepSeek Harness: one notify() API, 26 outbound channels, and optional five-channel two-way remote approval and conversation.

release.changelog: v0.3.0 adds five-channel two-way inbound (telegram/feishu/qq/wxpusher/wechat) for remote approval and conversation, on top of the unified notify() API and 26 outbound channels. This submission declares the omdsh-workshop-package/v1 dshWorkshop intake manifest.

management.label: dsh-notifier (cordis.patch.yml profile bundle)
management.instructions: Install the npm package through the DeepSeek Harness profile bundle mechanism (dsh plugin add dsh-notifier), then restart the profile. Configure one or more channels in the profile cordis.patch.yml as documented in the repository README; with no channels configured the plugin subscribes but takes no action and never breaks startup.

declarations.permissions: Outbound HTTP(S) to the configured notification channel APIs (Telegram/Slack/Discord/Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/QQ official bot/OneBot/Teams/Mattermost/Google Chat plus generic webhooks); optional inbound stack when configured — WebSocket client connections (Feishu/QQ), long polling (Telegram/WeChat iLink), and one HTTP callback listener (WxPusher on 127.0.0.1:8103); local JSONL ledger and JSON state store under the configured stateDir. No subprocess, no shell, no native code, no install scripts; secrets supported via ${ENV:NAME} references and never echoed.
declarations.testing: 329 node:test cases pass at the pinned commit (zero runtime dependencies, pure ESM). The suite covers channel adapters, routing, approval/conversation router, the five inbound channels, ledger/digest, segmentation, and tool registration.

capability.invocation: invoke the model-facing notify tool with a message and an optional target channel through the DSH ToolRuntime
capability.expected: the message is delivered to the configured channel (e.g. Telegram) and a structured result is returned; an unreachable or unconfigured channel returns a structured skipped/failed result without blocking the turn
